summary: Guard-gated dispatch accessor: when the guard flag at this[16] (offset 0x40) is non-zero, forwards argument a2 to LookupDispatch with sentinel -1 and returns its result; otherwise returns -1 immediately without dispatching.

operations.description: Guard on guard flag this[16] (byte offset 0x40): non-zero enables the dispatch path, zero short-circuits to -1.
When the guard flag is set, call LookupDispatch(a2, -1) and adopt its return value.
Return the LookupDispatch result when the guard is set, otherwise return the sentinel -1.

unresolved: Meaning of the dispatch key a2 and sentinel -1 depend on LookupDispatch's contract, which is external to this function.
Callers GameMode (0x0046D6D0) and sub_46FC30 (0x0046FC30) supply the guarded object and key, but the caller-side semantic of the guard flag is not established.
